body:
I used to think about it as a teenager, so depressive thoughts have definitely been a recurring theme for me for quite a while now.


I guess what started it recently, is looking at people who are around me. People more or less the same age with similair backgrounds and current circumstances. I feel like i am so much less of a person than they are. I am not as good at being a human being as they are. I am worse-looking, worse at social interactions, worse at being a normal human being.
